say:2:1110127001:1.text: Don't let Soren's gruff nature fool you. He's excellent at cooking meat!
say:2:1110127001:1.source_cn: 别看索恩一副不善言谈的样子，他烤肉的手艺可是非常厉害！

say:4:1110127002:1.text: Of course, this is the way of the Uru Clan. Have you finished exploring our camp?
say:4:1110127002:1.source_cn: 应该的，这是乌尔氏族的待客之道。你们已经在族内逛完了吗？

say:4:1110127002:1.female: Of course, this is the way of the Uru Clan. Have you finished exploring our camp?

say:5:1110127003:1.text: We spoke to a few young Maulers, but the magister is concerned about something...
say:5:1110127003:1.source_cn: 我们跟几个小蛮血搭了话，不过，主人很在意一件事呢……

say:7:1110127004:1.text: You noticed, huh? Actually, the thing about the Uru Clan is that there's really no common blood between us.
say:7:1110127004:1.source_cn: 你果然注意到了吗？其实，乌尔氏族不是通常意义上的氏族。...

say:8:1110127005:1.text: They... We're all the weak members abandoned by other clans. Our pops was the one that took us in.
say:8:1110127005:1.source_cn: 他们……我们都是其它氏族舍弃的弱小，从沙漠各处被老爹捡来。

say:9:1110127006:1.text: When he passed away, Soren and I were left to take care of everyone.
say:9:1110127006:1.source_cn: 后来，老爹去世，就剩下我跟索恩带着他们一起生活。

choice_prompt:10:1110127006.text: When he passed away, Soren and I were left to take care of everyone.
choice_prompt:10:1110127006.source_cn: 后来，老爹去世，就剩下我跟索恩带着他们一起生活。

say:11:1110127007:1.text: This is how it should be, right? Weak Maulers have to stick together to survive in this cruel desert.
say:11:1110127007:1.source_cn: 这也是应该的吧，弱小的蛮血要抱团生活，才能在这个残酷的...

say:12:1110127008:1.text: However, since we have each other, we're never alone.
say:12:1110127008:1.source_cn: 更何况大家一起生活，一点都不孤独呢。

choice:6:0:1.text: Where are all the older Maulers?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 为什么这里只有年少的蛮血？
choice:6:0:1.male: Where are all the older Maulers?
